fullPassage: Many factors contribute to Americans' growing waistlines, but one observation in particular cannot be overlooked: The incidence of obesity has increased in parallel with increasing portion sizes. Consider this: Adults today consume an average of 300 more calories per day than they did in the year 1985. Is this just a coincidence, or do larger portion sizes have something to do with it? In almost every eating situation, we are now confronted by huge portions, which are perceived as "normal" or "a great value." Americans have created the perception that large portion sizes are appropriate, creating an environment of portion distortion. We find portion distortions in restaurants, where the jumbo-sized portions are consistently 250 percent larger than the regular portions. We even find portion distortions in our homes, where the sizes of our bowls and glasses have steadily increased and where the surface area of the average dinner plate has increased 36 percent since 1960. Research shows that people unintentionally consume more calories when offered larger portions. Consuming larger portion sizes can contribute to positive energy balance, which, over time, leads to weight gain and ultimately can result in obesity.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 많은 요인들이 미국인들의 허리둘레 증가에 기여한다(contribute). 한 가지 관찰은 간과할 수 없다(overlooked). 비만의 발생률(incidence)이 증가했다.

❌②distribute(분배하다): contribute(기여하다)와 다른 의미
❌③overwhelmed(압도된): overlooked(간과된)과 다른 의미
❌④accident(사고): incidence(발생률)와 다른 의미
det.tip: contribute to(~에 기여하다), overlook(간과하다), incidence(발생률) vs accident(사고)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

❌②intentionally(의도적으로): unintentionally(의도치 않게)의 반의어

Americans have created the perception that large portion sizes are appropriate, creating an environment of portion distortion. We find portion distortions in restaurants, where the jumbo-sized portions are consistently 250 percent larger than the regular portions. We even find portion distortions in our homes, where the sizes of our bowls and glasses have steadily increased and where the surface area of the average dinner plate has increased 36 percent since 1960. Research shows that people unintentionally consume more calories when offered larger portions. Consuming larger portion sizes can contribute to positive energy balance, which, over time, leads to weight gain and ultimately can result in obesity.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 increased와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 그릇과 유리잔의 크기가 꾸준히 증가했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① expanded ❌ ④ multiplied ❌ ③ accumulated ✅ ② diminished ✅④diminished: 줄어들다 — increased(증가하다)의 반의어
❌①expanded: 확대되다 — 유사 의미
❌②multiplied: 배가 되다 — 유사 의미
❌③accumulated: 축적되다 — 유사 의미
det.tip: increase(증가하다) ↔ decrease = diminish = decline(감소하다)

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 contribute의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 많은 요인들이 허리둘레 증가에 기여한다. (B) 그녀는 자선 기금에 500달러를 기부하기로 했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 기부하다 — 원인으로 작용하다 ❌ ② 참여하다 — 기부하다 ✅ ④ 생산하다 — 참여하다 ❌ ③ 원인으로 작용하다 — 기부하다 ✅③원인으로 작용하다 — 기부하다: (A)는 원인/기여, (B)는 금전적 기부
❌①기부하다 — 원인으로 작용하다: (A)(B) 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌②참여하다 — 기부하다: (A)는 참여가 아닌 원인
❌④생산하다 — 참여하다: 둘 다 의미 부적절
det.tip: contribute: ①기여하다/원인이 되다 (to) ②기부하다 (to) ③공헌하다

questions.stem:

det.korean: 무언가의 형태나 진실을 바꿔 더 이상 정확하지 않게 만드는 행위
det.analysis:
❌ ① proportion ✅ ④ distortion ❌ ③ perception ❌ ② consumption ✅②distortion: 왜곡 — 형태나 사실을 변형하는 것
❌①proportion: 비율 — 다른 의미
❌③perception: 인식 — 인지하는 것
❌④consumption: 소비 — 다른 의미
det.tip: distortion = distort(왜곡하다)의 명사형. 사실/형태를 비틀어 바꾸는 것

questions.passage: We find portion distortions in restaurants. The jumbo-sized portions are __________ (consist) 250 percent larger than the regular portions. We even find portion distortions in our homes, where the sizes of our bowls and glasses have steadily increased.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어 (영어로))

det.analysis: consist(동사) → consistently(부사): 형용사 larger를 수식하므로 부사형 필요
det.tip: consist(구성되다) → consistent(일관된, 형용사) → consistently(일관되게, 부사)

det.tip: intention(의도) → intentional(의도적인) → intentionally(의도적으로) → un + intentionally = unintentionally(의도치 않게)
